title: Trump wants Big Pharma to split MMR vaccine; Big Pharma thinks it's idiotic
summary: Within hours of Trump signing the order, PhRMA—the leading pharmaceutical industry group representing big players, such as GSK, Sanofi, Pfizer, Merck, Johnson & Johnson, and Novo Nordisk—put out a statement saying the order debases America’s vaccine policy.
